note: City of Forest City park along the Winnebago River near the suspension bridge; enter Pammel Park from East J Street on the south side. Accepts big rigs. The pads sit in a strip between two park roads, and the east row looks across the riverside road at the river through scattered bank trees. RV Life 7.9/10, $. --Claude
summary: The Forest City page confirms the identity (city campground in Pammel Park, Forest City, by the Winnebago River and suspension bridge), $20/night paid at the campground, 43 pads with electric, showerhouse/restrooms and dump. The stored $25 reservation fee was the pavilion's and is cleared. Riverview stands; pin OK.
flags: IDENTITY: confirmed as the City of Forest City's Pammel Park (pin, website and wording all Forest City / Winnebago River). Madison County's Pammel Park near Winterset is a separate entry (3061, 41.29063,-94.06924), and this record carries nothing from it.

FEES CORRECTION: reservation_fee 25 cleared. On the city page that sentence ('Reservations are accepted beginning April 1. The reservation fee is $25.00 ...') sits under the Jerry Tweeten Pavilion (Merrick Park) shelter house; the campground entry says only '$20.00 per night, payable at the campground'. No campground reservations are stated, so booking FCFS (derived) stays.

WATERFRONT: 'riverview' stands. On NAIP the pads are angled spurs in a strip between two park roads (~43.2591,-93.6313); the east road runs along the river bank, and the Winnebago is about 27-30 m wide here. That puts it at the river/creek line, but the river is named and this is a view value, so no width call is needed. A road between rules out riverfront. The bank strip carries only scattered trees, so the east row sees the water about 15-25 m away across the road. The old note's 'screened from the river by a treeline' does not match either image and was rewritten.

NOTE CORRECTIONS: dropped '~$15/night' (the page says $20), '41 with 30-amp (partial hookups)' (the page says all 43 pads have RV electrical hookups) and the redundant FCFS/shower/dump text. hookups.electric 30 (derived) was left, since the page gives no amperage.
